CustomField.description: True when this is gala money: it came from a gala source (Gala Website = the gala Jotform; JCRC Website - Gala = a jcrcny.org/donate gift designated to the gala), or its Fund or Campaign is ticked Gala (e.g. a QuickBooks gift to the Gala Fund). Drives the Gala tab on the Pending Transactions screen and whether an Event Registration may be linked. JSI-121 / Jason Ott.
CustomField.formula: OR( ISPICKVAL(Source__c, "Gala Website"), ISPICKVAL(Source__c, "JCRC Website - Gala"), Fund__r.Gala__c, Campaign__r.Gala__c )
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Gala money: from a gala source, or with a gala fund or campaign.
CustomField.label: Is Gala
